external_aero.why: Atmospheric freestream on fins/nose/fairings during ascent.

nozzle_compressible.why: De Laval / bell nozzle: choked throat + expansion. Density-based.

chamber_internal.why: Chamber / regen channel internal gas path (steady RANS).

injector_orifice.why: Injector pressure drop / Cd at manifold Δp (liquid or cold-flow gas).

valve_feed.why: Propellant valve / actuator flow path: Δp and Cv proxy.

igniter_internal.why: Igniter gas path; same machinery as chamber internal, smaller domain.

tank_ullage_optional.why: Only if geometry is a clear vessel interior; primary truth is FEA MEOP.

radiator_loop_optional.why: Rare: radiator / cold-plate fluid loops on buses. Not external aero.

skip_exoatmospheric.why: CubeSat / bus / deployable / dish / solar: vacuum ops. Optimization is structural/thermal FEA (launch loads, modes), not freestream CFD.

skip_structure_fea.why: Brackets/frames/panels: FEA (6g / modal). External flow adds no training signal.
